title: Daydream feature in Nougat persists the status bar... can you turn that off?
symptom: When the xdrip+ daydream feature kicks in, the screen turns black and the graph and current BG values show up, but the status bar remains at the top with all its items (clock, notification icons) and is a bright blue color. The user is concerned about screen burn-in and wants nothing on screen except the floating graph and bg value.
fix: The developer added a preference option to display the status bar or not when in daydream mode, and also set the status bar background colour to black. The user confirmed it works perfectly.
evidence_quote: Can you let me know if the June 10th Nightly resolves this issue? So far I have tried to set the status bar background colour to black.
